capabilities: Import notes and captioned images from a Hunchly export case file (zip)
Consolidate notes taken on the same URL into one note
Add Hunchly selectors as Obsidian tags
Choose a destination folder relative to the vault root
Open an import modal from a H ribbon icon
extras: The README is short and example-free; the export zip is produced via the Export Case option in the Hunchly Dashboard.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring web-capture evidence from Hunchly investigations into notes.

relations.evidence: Hunchly is a web capture tool designed For online investigations

summary: Imports Hunchly case exports, converting captured notes and captioned images into Obsidian notes with selectors as tags.
